name: list_agents
description: List agents available in the connected SandBase Harness runtime.

name: create_session
description: Create a SandBase Harness session for an agent.

arguments.name: environment_id
arguments.desc: Optional environment ID for the session.

name: run_session
description: Send a message to a session and wait until its streamed turn becomes idle.

arguments.name: session_id
arguments.desc: ID of the session to run.

arguments.name: message
arguments.desc: Non-empty user message to send to the session.

name: get_session
description: Get the current state and usage of a SandBase Harness session.

arguments.name: session_id
arguments.desc: ID of the session to inspect.

name: list_artifacts
description: List artifacts produced by a SandBase Harness session.

arguments.name: session_id
arguments.desc: ID of the session whose artifacts should be listed.

name: stop_session
description: Stop a running SandBase Harness session.

arguments.name: session_id
arguments.desc: ID of the session to stop.
